notes: Stories defined for frontend map rendering aligned to provider search outputs.

stories.title: Map Data Contract for Provider Locations
stories.description: Define frontend data contract for map rendering including provider_id, name, latitude, longitude, specialty, and display metadata. Ensure compatibility with provider search outputs.

stories.title: Core Map Rendering Component
stories.description: Implement core frontend map component capable of initializing map instance, centering based on search results, and rendering provider markers using the defined contract.

stories.title: Provider Marker UI and Interaction
stories.description: Build UI logic for interactive provider markers including hover/click states, info popups with provider details, and selection behavior tied to search results.

stories.title: Integration with Provider Search Results
stories.description: Integrate map component with existing provider search flow to dynamically update markers based on search responses and user queries.

stories.title: Map Rendering and Interaction Tests
stories.description: Develop frontend tests to validate map initialization, marker rendering accuracy, interaction behavior, and synchronization with provider search results.
